comparisons.peer_summary: The All Other category, which is not a reportable segment, includes expenses and credits not allocated to segments for performance evaluation, such as amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, stock-based compensation, restructuring charges, and licensing gains.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and AMD disclose an 'All Other' category for financial results that do not fall into specific reportable operating segments. Intel's 'all other' category is defined by the specific business units included, such as Altera, Mobileye, and startup initiatives, whereas AMD defines its category by the types of unallocated financial items, such as amortization of intangibles, stock-based compensation, and restructuring charges.

sentences.text: Our "all other" category includes the results of operations from other non-reportable segments not otherwise presented, including our Altera and Mobileye businesses, start-up businesses that support our initiatives, and historical results of operations from divested businesses.
This category primarily includes amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, employee stock-based compensation, acquisition-related and other costs, restructuring charges and licensing gain.
